name: SAMSum: Dialogue Abstractive Summarization Corpus
description: SAMSum is an abstractive summarization corpus containing 16,369 English messenger-like dialogues written by linguists reflecting typical mobile and online conversations, each paired with an expert human-written summary.

source_references.title: SAMSum Corpus: A Human-annotated Dialogue Dataset for Abstractive Summarization
source_references.notes: Published in Proceedings of the 2nd Workshop on New Frontiers in Summarization (EMNLP-IJCNLP 2019).

verification.notes: Verified against EMNLP 2019 workshop paper (DOI: 10.18653/v1/D19-5409) and Hugging Face release. Exactly 16,369 dialogues partitioned into 14,732 training, 818 validation, and 819 test pairs.

size.notes: JSON formatted dialogue and summary splits.
